# **Artist Analytics – Data Dictionary & Schema**

Two APIs (setlist.fm and MusicBrainz) are fed into a Snowflake star schema with two fact tables (shows, songs played at shows) and four dimension tables, joined on MusicBrainz artist ids and a normalized song title. The MusicBrainz ID is a shared ID that is used on MusicBrainz and on the [setlist.fm](http://setlist.fm) API, so this is a simple join.

## **Sources**

Both sources are pulled with the Alteryx Download tool and joined on the MusicBrainz artist id (MBID), which setlist.fm uses natively.

| Source | Method | What it provides | Raw table | Raw grain | Rows |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| [setlist.fm API](https://api.setlist.fm/docs/1.0/index.html) | `/artist/{mbid}/setlists`, paged by `total` (20 per page), throttled to 1 call/sec, 429 retries | Every show for 5 artists: date, venue, tour, songs in order | `DS_SETLIST_DATA_RAW` | One row per setlist (show) | 3,448 |
| [MusicBrainz API](https://musicbrainz.org/doc/MusicBrainz_API) | `/release-group?artist={mbid}&type=album` | Every album-type release per artist | `DS_RELEASE_GROUPS_RAW` | One row per release group (album) | 104 |
| [MusicBrainz API](https://musicbrainz.org/doc/MusicBrainz_API) | `/release?release-group={id}&inc=recordings`, flattened to tracks in Alteryx; busy-server calls backfilled and unioned | Tracklists of every edition of each album | `DS_TRACKS_RAW` | One row per track per release edition | 5,745 |

Artists I chose: Bruno Mars, Mac DeMarco, Kendrick Lamar, Sabrina Carpenter, Daniel Caesar. The API key is read from a local file, not stored in the workflow. To make your own key, go to [https\://www\.setlist.fm/settings/apps](https://www.setlist.fm/settings/apps).

## **Tables**

There are 6 tables: four dimensions then two facts at different grains

| Table | Type | Grain | Primary key | Key fields | Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| `DS_ARTIST` | Dimension | One row per artist | `ARTIST_MBID` | `ARTIST_NAME` | The 5 artists |
| `DS_VENUE` | Dimension | One row per venue | `VENUE_ID` | `VENUE_NAME`, `CITY_NAME`, `STATE_CODE`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `LATITUDE`, `LONGITUDE` | Every venue played, parsed from setlist venue JSON; feeds maps. |
| `DS_ALBUM` | Dimension | One row per core album | `ALBUM_ID` (MusicBrainz release group id) | `ARTIST_MBID`, `ALBUM_TITLE`, `RELEASE_DATE`, `ALBUM_CATEGORY`, `STUDIO_ALBUM_NUMBER`, `IS_LATEST_STUDIO_ALBUM` | 29 curated albums: studio albums and two Kendrick Lamar non-studio releases that were relevant |
| `DS_SONG` | Dimension | One row per song per artist | `SONG_ID` (`ARTIST_MBID` \+ `|` \+ `SONG_KEY`) | `SONG_KEY`, `SONG_TITLE`, `ALBUM_ID`, `SONG_SOURCE`, `IS_BONUS_TRACK` | Every album song plus every song played live that is not on a core album (Cover or Non-album). |
| `DS_SHOW` | Fact | One row per past show | `SETLIST_ID` | `ARTIST_MBID`, `VENUE_ID`, `EVENT_DATE`, `TOUR_NAME`, `CYCLE_ALBUM_ID`, `SONGS_PLAYED`, `CYCLE_ALBUM_SONGS`, `CYCLE_ALBUM_SHARE`, `IS_STUB`, `SETLIST_URL` | Executive view: shows, markets and new-album share. |
| `DS_SONG_PERFORMANCE` | Fact | One row per song played per show | `SETLIST_ID` \+ `POSITION_IN_SHOW` | `SONG_ID`, `ALBUM_ID`, `ARTIST_MBID`, `EVENT_DATE`, `SET_NUMBER`, `IS_ENCORE`, `IS_COVER`, `GUEST_ARTIST`, `IS_CYCLE_ALBUM_SONG` | Analyst view: song retention, setlist order, row-level detail. |

## **How the sources join**

Every join is an exact id except song matching, which uses a normalized title and matches 75–85% of songs played per artist.

| From | To | Join on | Cardinality | Notes |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| `DS_SHOW` | `DS_ARTIST` | `ARTIST_MBID` | Many to one | setlist.fm stores the MusicBrainz artist id |
| `DS_SHOW` | `DS_VENUE` | `VENUE_ID` | Many to one | setlist.fm venue id |
| `DS_SHOW` | `DS_ALBUM` | `CYCLE_ALBUM_ID` \= `ALBUM_ID` | Many to one | The album the show was promoting |
| `DS_SONG_PERFORMANCE` | `DS_SHOW` | `SETLIST_ID` | Many to one | Songs within a show |
| `DS_SONG_PERFORMANCE` | `DS_SONG` | `SONG_ID` | Many to one | Built from `ARTIST_MBID` \+ normalized song title |
| `DS_SONG_PERFORMANCE` | `DS_ALBUM` | `ALBUM_ID` | Many to one | Null for covers and non-album songs |
| `DS_SONG_PERFORMANCE` | `DS_ARTIST` | `ARTIST_MBID` | Many to one |  |
| `DS_SONG` | `DS_ALBUM` | `ALBUM_ID` | Many to one | Each song's respective album |
| `DS_SONG` / `DS_ALBUM` | `DS_ARTIST` | `ARTIST_MBID` | Many to one |  |

**Bridging between [setlist.fm](http://setlist.fm) and MusicBrainz:** setlist.fm song titles meet MusicBrainz track titles through `SONG_KEY`: lowercase, bracketed suffixes such as (feat. …) or \[Live\] removed, & turned into "and", punctuation stripped. Snowflake records the primary and foreign keys but does not enforce them; Tableau relationships use the same keys.

## **Business rules**

| Rule | Definition | Why |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Cycle album | The artist's latest studio album released on or before the show date | New-album share follows the calendar: Sabrina Carpenter's shows after Aug 29, 2025 count against *Man's Best Friend* |
| Core albums | 29 hand-picked release groups; excludes bootlegs, demos, live albums, fan compilations and Mac DeMarco's instrumental *Five Easy Hot Dogs* | MusicBrainz lists 104 "albums", many unofficial |
| Home album | A song belongs to the earliest core album it appears on | Reissues and compilations would otherwise double-count it |
| Bonus track | On fewer than half of an album's editions | Separates deluxe-only songs |
| Tape songs | Excluded from songs played | Intros and walk-on music which are not performed |
| Stub shows | `IS_STUB` \= no songs logged; kept in show counts | The show happened; fans did not log it |
| Future shows | Excluded from `DS_SHOW` | Announced but not yet played |

## **Tool choices**

| Step | Tool | Why |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| API calls and throttling | Alteryx | Download, Generate Rows and Throttle handle paging and limits visually and the api key stays in a local file |
| Tracklists to one row per track | Alteryx | Nested tracklist JSON exceeded file cell limits, so it was flattened a few times before exporting out |
| Load | Snowflake | Three raw CSVs loaded into Snowflake |
| Setlist songs to rows | SQL | Unnests sets and songs while keeping their order through the flatten index |
| Cleaning and modeling | SQL | Date parsing, title normalization, edition collapsing, cycle-album logic in one script |
